name: su_Pt10_CeO2_111
title: Pt10 / CeO2(111)
description: Pt10 on a frozen O-terminated CeO2(111) slab (3 O-Ce-O trilayers, 5x5 cell, 225 atoms; NEP89 a = 5.438 A vs exp. 5.411 A), a model of Pt/ceria oxidation and three-way catalysts. The NEP89 putative GM is a 3D Pt7+3 bilayer bound to surface O (Pt-O 1.99 A), and NEP89 Pt8 is planar, in line with the DFT 2D-to-3D transition above Pt8 for Pt_N on CeO2(111) (Paz-Borbon et al., Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 19, 17845 (2017)). NEP89 is charge-neutral: the Pt-to-ceria electron transfer and Ce4+ -> Ce3+ reduction found by DFT are not described, and the frozen slab excludes O spillover and vacancy formation.
